queries.Overall research design: We will conduct: Cross-sectional study of postmenopausal women with type 2 diabetes and obesity measuring serum TNF-alpha, IL-6, adiponectin, trabecular bone inflammatory and Wnt pathway gene expression, micro-CT bone microarchitecture, and compression mechanical properties to assess inflammation Wnt signaling bone quality relationships.
queries.Cohort recruitment and grouping: We will: Recruitment and grouping of postmenopausal women over 65 undergoing hip replacement for osteoarthritis into type 2 diabetes with obesity, obesity with normal glucose metabolism, and normal weight controls, with HbA1c and BMI criteria, to examine inflammation, Wnt signaling, and bone quality.
queries.Systemic inflammation measurement: We wi: Preoperative fasting serum measurement of TNF-alpha, IL-6, and adiponectin in postmenopausal women with type 2 diabetes and obesity using ELLA microfluidic immunoassay and ELISA to evaluate systemic inflammation related to bone quality and Wnt signaling.
queries.Local bone inflammation and Wnt gene exp: real-time PCR analysis of inflammatory markers and Wnt signaling genes TNF-alpha IL-6 IL-8 IL-10 ADIPOQ SFRP5 SOST WNT10B LEF-1 WNT5A GSK3B in femoral head trabecular bone from postmenopausal women with type 2 diabetes and obesity
queries.Bone microarchitecture assessment: For b: Micro-CT analysis of trabecular bone microarchitecture in postmenopausal women with type 2 diabetes and obesity, measuring bone volume fraction, connectivity density, trabecular thickness, trabecular number, trabecular separation, tissue mineral density, and volumetric bone mineral density.
queries.Bone mechanical property assessment: We: compression testing of trabecular bone specimens to determine Young's modulus, ultimate strength, and yield strength in postmenopausal women with type 2 diabetes and obesity
queries.Statistical testing of associations: Sta: statistical association analysis using Spearman correlation between inflammatory markers, Wnt signaling gene expression, and bone strength in postmenopausal women with type 2 diabetes and obesity
queries.Body composition and BMD assessment: We: dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry measurement of body composition, bone mineral density, and visceral adipose tissue in postmenopausal women with type 2 diabetes and obesity
queries.Covariate collection: Clinical character: Recording clinical characteristics such as fasting glucose, HbA1c, lipid profiles, and kidney function parameters in postmenopausal women with type 2 diabetes, obesity, and bone quality assessment.
queries.Participant eligibility control: We will: Participant eligibility criteria for postmenopausal women with type 2 diabetes and obesity in a bone quality and Wnt signaling study, excluding diseases affecting bone metabolism, inflammatory conditions, malignancy, and medications affecting bone metabolism
